name: Atitlán
summary: A volcanic caldera-lake system in the Guatemalan highlands, flagged in INDE's 1980s–90s national geothermal reconnaissance as geologically favorable, though early geothermometry data from that period was not considered reliable enough to rank it alongside the country's priority fields. Currently an early-stage area of renewed interest rather than a characterised resource — detailed temperature and capacity figures are pending further field work.
